requirements.requirement: The system must parse sponsor name, type, funding source, collaborators, and score contribution fields from the schema defined in ST-001.
The system must normalize funding source values into one of: public, private, or undisclosed.
The system must format collaborator lists into a human-readable comma-separated string.
The system must generate a display-ready score contribution string from raw score contribution data.
The system must output a structured object containing only display-ready fields for UI consumption.
The system must ensure all output fields are non-null strings or explicitly labeled placeholders when data is missing.
The system must preserve original sponsor name text without modification except trimming whitespace.
The system must handle multiple collaborators by limiting display to a maximum of N entries and appending '+X more' when exceeded.
The system must default funding source to 'undisclosed' when input value is missing or unrecognized.
The system must not throw runtime errors when sponsor data fields are partially missing.
The system must log a warning when required sponsor fields are missing or malformed.
The system must ensure transformation logic executes within the MessageBubble rendering pipeline without blocking rendering.
The system must generate consistent output formatting for identical input sponsor data across renders.
The system must support LLM-generated sponsor data by validating and sanitizing all incoming text fields before transformation.
The system must normalize inconsistent LLM-provided funding labels (e.g., 'govt', 'industry', 'unknown') into the standard set.
The system must collapse duplicate collaborator entries when provided by LLM or backend data.
The system must truncate excessively long LLM-generated text fields to a safe display length.
The system must prevent injection of HTML or script content in LLM-generated sponsor fields.
The system must generate human-readable fallback text when score contribution data is missing.
The system must ensure output object structure strictly matches the schema defined in ST-001.
